description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git rebase --fork-point' functionality in a Git repository. It sets up a commit graph, runs various rebase commands with different options, and verifies the expected output to ensure correct behavior of the rebase feature.

methods.name: do_test_rebase
methods.description: Performs a rebase operation with specified parameters and verifies the output against expected results.

methods.name: test_rebase
methods.description: Wraps 'do_test_rebase' with a success expectation, running a rebase with given parameters and verifying the output.
